annotation: Assistant review against the pre-existing RX41 source fixture and acceptance scenarios. Not an exhaustive or independently double-annotated accuracy benchmark. Recovery and precision are assessed separately; model support labels are not ground truth.

scenarios.notes: All three Cellula Verde mentions remain GROUP with no terrorist subtype; no identity merge into another organization.

A-01 affiliation and F-06 transfer gaps retained as not_documented. Reviewer wrongly rejects the correctly encoded A-01 gap. D2 affiliation denial is correctly rejected, but other absence statements still become supported denials.
SA-02 allegation and CG-01 denial are separately attributed and joined by candidate_contradicts with identity review required. No source is adjudicated true.

ST-05 and EC-03 claims retain 240 EUR and EC-03 interval in qualifiers. Document-to-document CONTRADICTS is extracted, but no claim comparison connects this pair because qualification sets differ. A separate unsupported-by-source denial from an evidence-gap sentence is wrongly marked supported.

RE-02 retraction is explicit, identities remain separate and original CE-03 editorial relations survive. A later editorial statement is also misrepresented as the channel publishing the catalog; the original uncertainty statement is incorrectly represented as withdrawal of certainty.

Correction stores 10 February in new_date and references RT-04 11 February for the same attack. Distinct hostage event retains 11 February. Earlier dates use malformed document-as-event endpoints, preventing resolved correction comparison.
No alternative location invented, but BL-08 withdrawal is encoded and endorsed as ceases rather than retracts; that changes the historical meaning.

Withdrawal of attributed certainty is retained and references RT-04, with a candidate link to prior responsibility. It is not an acquittal. The affected event endpoint is omitted and UT-09 is not retained as a separate structured source.
March 1 activity, February 21-March 2 history and March 3 cessation survive. An additional false cessation involving the library is wrongly endorsed; its existence prevents a clean precision pass.

No derived_from records or dependent_source comparison. Original CE-03 and Scheda source names are retained, but NI-01/RI-02 transcription ancestry is not reconstructed and RE-02 retransmission is not recognized as dependent.

A-01 and F-06 evidence gaps are correctly represented but wrongly rejected by the reviewer. RE-02 campaign-management gaps are now correctly supported. Several other absence statements still become endorsed denials.
SA-02 allegation and CG-01 denial remain separately attributed and linked as a candidate contradiction, requiring identity review.

The original EC-03 denial preserves the 16 February-4 March interval but is not linked to ST-05. A second denial is linked to the allegation only after its temporal interval has been omitted. This is not a clean recovery of the scoped comparison.

The explicit identity retraction and all three original editorial relations survive. The wrong catalog-publication assertion is now rejected. The initial uncertainty is still also misrepresented as a withdrawal; the identity-retraction claim has no resolved prior-claim link.

The temporal pass adds correctly oriented event/date literals. The 10 February correction links to the prior 11 February value for the same attack; the hostage event stays distinct. Earlier malformed document-as-event assertions remain supported.
Both extraction passes encode the assertion retraction as cessation. A reference to BL-08 is added, but it does not fix the operation kind. No alternative location is invented.

The original withdrawal-of-certainty claim and its RT-04 comparison survive without acquittal. UT-09 is now named as a source, but its new claim puts the speaker in the RESPONSIBLE_FOR subject position. A further generic retraction makes the scope less explicit.

Activity at 1 March, the 21 February-2 March history, cessation from 3 March and continuing educational collaboration are retained. The false library-related cessation is now rejected. A separate earlier document-as-participant error remains; duplicate formulations and differing source designations persist.

Three derived_from records concern other sources, not NI-01/RI-02. RT-04 citing BL-08 is represented correctly; copying the hostage date from Documento 1 is inferred without source support. A further ancestry record belongs to a contradicted, misattributed correction. The nine dependent_source links do not establish the required transcription ancestry.
